canDo: Can locate conditions, limits and actions in 150–250-word practical texts, and understand the gérondif, dont/compound relative pronouns and relative time markers.
review: Learn the gérondif, dont/compound relative pronouns and B1 markers such as la veille/le lendemain/d’ici; practise scanning strategies at the same time.
output: Write a 2-sentence summary in French; restate the key actions aloud.
checkpoint: Objective questions + main idea done; can explain what at least 4 long sentences/time markers do.
challenge: Today’s challenge: on the website or notice board of your town (or any French town) — library opening hours, how to get an ID document — find a French text of about 150 words; mark 3 conditions, 2 limits and 1 required action, and sum it up with 1 sentence using the gérondif and 1 using dont.

questions.why: The text states this replacement explicitly.
The first 4 hours cost 5 €, then 3 € for each further 4 hours or part of 4 hours: 9 hours = 4 + 4 + 1, so 5 + 3 + 3 = 11 €.
